description: Find services or products for a specific buyer request. Returns JSON text with ranked results, structured offers, listing slugs, agent.json URLs, and applied filters. Use nexez_directory for broad browsing, then nexez_get_page to inspect an exact offer before a dry run.

category.description: Marketplace category; omit or use all to include both professional and consumer listings.

industry.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the published industry, for example plumbing.

lat.description: Optional latitude context metadata. Does not filter or rerank results; use location for geographic filtering.

limit.description: Maximum results; defaults to 10 and is rounded down and clamped to 1-50.

lng.description: Optional longitude context metadata. Does not filter or rerank results; use location for geographic filtering.

min_readiness.description: Minimum listing readiness score (0-100); omit for no readiness threshold.

min_trust.description: Minimum marketplace trust score (0-100); omit for no trust threshold. Not a guarantee of seller performance.

nexez_checkout_ready.description: Owner payout state confirms Nexez-settled checkout readiness

price_band.description: Filter by the listing marketplace price band. Inspect the exact offer for its price and currency; this is not a checkout quote.

q.description: What the buyer is looking for

supports_checkout.description: Deprecated compatibility filter: any actionable offer or provider handoff

supports_negotiation.description: Filter by negotiation availability: true for eligible listings, false for non-negotiable listings; omit to include both.

verified.description: Filter by seller verification signal: true requires a signal, false requires its absence; omit to include both.

name: nexez_search
title: Search Nexez offers
